name: Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts
summary: A bundle of Atal’ai artifacts is carried from the Pool of Tears to an exiled priest in the Hinterlands. Its purpose is tied to the tribe’s rites.

sections.title: A Blood-Written Sentence
sections.body: A blood-written sentence found near the Pool of Tears condemns an Atal’ai priest to exile. The artifacts gathered there are meant for the priest, who has taken refuge among the Witherbark trolls in the Hinterlands. He is asked to reveal their true use.

sections.title: The Artifacts’ Purpose
sections.body: The exile identifies the bundle as summoning artifacts. Jammal’an the Prophet leads disciples of the Chamber of Blood toward their chosen fate, and the question remains whether Hakkar has returned to the Temple.

faq.q: What are the Atal’ai artifacts for?
faq.answer: The exiled priest identifies the Atal’ai artifacts as summoning artifacts.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the bundle?
faq.answer: The bundle is meant for an exiled Atal’ai priest living among the Witherbark trolls in the Hinterlands.
The priest was sentenced to exile by the Atal’ai tribe. The sentence does not give a reason.

faq.q: Who leads the Chamber of Blood disciples?
faq.answer: Jammal’an the Prophet leads the disciples of the Chamber of Blood.

faq.q: Has Hakkar returned to the Temple?
faq.answer: The priest wonders whether Hakkar has returned to the Temple; his return is not confirmed.

angles.text: The bundle concerns Atal’ai rites and an exile living among the Witherbark trolls in the Hinterlands.
